description: Optional AI coaching boundary: a mobile client adapter (no key, no SDK), the Settings disclosure + toggle wired through setAiCoaching, the practice-hint integration with graceful local fallback, an isolated server/ stub + README, the docs/ai-coaching.md disclosure, and the AI adapter tests. OFF BY DEFAULT and server-side-only. DEPENDS ON FEAT-002 (CoachingFeedback), FEAT-003 (PersistedAiCoaching), FEAT-004 (setAiCoaching + the ResultScreen practice coaching call site). The root app stays fully functional without any of this.
steps: Create src/ai/coachingClient.ts (design 9.2): export interface AiCoachingConfig { enabled: boolean; endpointUrl: string | null; timeoutMs: number } (default enabled:false, endpointUrl:null, timeoutMs:4000) and async fetchAiHint(input: { lessonId; prompt; suggestedAnswer; studentText }, config): Promise<string | null>. If !config.enabled || !config.endpointUrl -> return null immediately (no network). Else POST JSON (studentText truncated to MAX_PRACTICE_TEXT) using the RN-global fetch + an AbortController timeout of config.timeoutMs. On any non-200, abort/timeout, network throw, or a JSON that fails the client shape-check (expect exactly { hint: string } with a non-empty, length-bounded hint; ignore/strip any other field such as score/xp/badge/certificate) -> return null. No new dependency, no SDK, NO API key on the device.

Integrate into the practice hint path (ResultScreen, using the provider's aiCoaching setting + build-time timeoutMs:4000 to build the AiCoachingConfig): when enabled and fetchAiHint returns a non-null hint, replace ONLY CoachingFeedback.hint and set source:'ai'; otherwise keep the local hint and source:'local'. Mastery grading, XP, badges, and certificates are never touched by this path. The UI must never block on the network nor surface a raw error for this optional path.

Modify src/ui/screens/SettingsScreen.tsx (design 9.4): add an AI-coaching section with the enable toggle (default off, DISABLED until the disclosure is acknowledged), an endpoint-URL entry, and the disclosure acknowledgement control. Persist each through the provider's setAiCoaching(next: PersistedAiCoaching). The in-app disclosure summarizes exactly what leaves the device when enabled (lesson id, lesson prompt, suggested answer, truncated practice text) and states nothing is sent while off.

Create server/ as an isolated service: server/package.json with pinned express 4.21.2 and @types/express 4.17.21 (and its OWN lockfile when installed) — do NOT add these to the root package.json/lockfile. Add a POST /coach/explain stub handler: request { lessonId, prompt, suggestedAnswer, studentText } (re-validate types + re-truncate studentText), response 200 { hint: string } with a deterministic canned hint, or a non-200 (e.g. 503) to exercise the client fallback. Read any provider API key from process.env SERVER-SIDE ONLY (a real provider call is a clearly-marked TODO). Treat studentText as untrusted (validate, never eval; if ever used in a provider prompt, place it in a quoted data section). Add server/README.md noting key-server-only + the TODO.

Create docs/ai-coaching.md documenting exactly what data leaves the device when the feature is enabled and an endpoint is configured (lesson id, lesson prompt, suggested answer, truncated student practice text, sent to the user-configured endpoint), what is NOT sent (no name, no progression, no XP, no device identifiers), that nothing is sent while the feature is off (the default), and the pre-enable in-app disclosure/acknowledgement requirement.

Create __tests__/aiCoaching.test.ts (design 8 items 30-33; mock the global fetch): feature flag off (default) -> adapter never called, feedback source:'local'; adapter timeout / non-200 / missing-config -> falls back to local feedback (source:'local'), no throw to the UI; a well-formed { hint } response replaces only the practice hint and sets source:'ai'; a malformed/shape-invalid response OR one that includes a score/xp/badge/certificate field is rejected/stripped to the hint only and falls back to local; assert the adapter never returns a score/XP/badge/certificate field.
acceptance_criteria: src/ai/coachingClient.ts exports AiCoachingConfig + fetchAiHint; with the feature off (default) it performs no network call and returns null; every failure mode (timeout, non-200, bad shape, missing config) returns null so coaching falls back to the deterministic local hint.
A well-formed AI response replaces ONLY CoachingFeedback.hint and sets source:'ai'; AI never changes a score, XP, badge, or certificate.
No API key and no AI SDK exist in the mobile bundle; server/ has its own package.json/lockfile and is not referenced by the root package.json.
Settings exposes the off-by-default toggle (disabled until acknowledged), endpoint entry, and disclosure, persisted via setAiCoaching; docs/ai-coaching.md documents what leaves the device.
Running `npm test -- aiCoaching` passes and the full `npm test` stays green; the root typecheck/lint/validator are unaffected by server/.
verification: node scripts/validate-catalog.mjs   still reports 3 tracks, 9 levels, 18 lessons, 45 mastery questions (content unchanged, server/ isolated)
findings:
Implemented the optional AI coaching boundary. All five verifications green: npm run typecheck exit 0; npm test -- aiCoaching = 13 passed; npm test (full) = 161 passed across 13 suites; npm run lint = 0 errors (only 4 pre-existing WARNINGS, none in FEAT-005 files: require-import in focus-screen/screens.smoke/store tests + an unused LevelId in src/domain/certificates/document.ts); node scripts/validate-catalog.mjs still reports 3 tracks, 9 levels, 18 lessons, 45 mastery questions.

NEW src/ai/coachingClient.ts (mobile adapter, NO key, NO SDK, no new dependency — uses the RN-global fetch + AbortController):
- interface AiCoachingConfig { enabled: boolean; endpointUrl: string | null; timeoutMs: number } and const DEFAULT_AI_COACHING_CONFIG = { enabled:false, endpointUrl:null, timeoutMs:4000 }.
- interface FetchAiHintInput { lessonId; prompt; suggestedAnswer; studentText }.
- async fetchAiHint(input, config): Promise<string | null>. If !config.enabled || !config.endpointUrl -> returns null immediately with NO network call. Else POSTs JSON (studentText truncated to MAX_PRACTICE_TEXT from ../domain/coaching) with an AbortController timeout of config.timeoutMs. On any non-200, abort/timeout, network throw, JSON parse failure, or a body that fails the client shape-check -> returns null. The shape-check (extractHint) accepts ONLY { hint: string } with a non-empty hint bounded to <= 2000 chars; every other field (score/xp/badge/certificate/passed/...) is ignored. The return type is string | null, so there is no structural surface for a score/XP/badge/certificate to ride along on.

ResultScreen integration (src/ui/screens/ResultScreen.tsx) — the FEAT-004 practice-coaching call site: the screen now reads aiCoaching from the provider and adds a SECOND effect (gated on saveStatus==='saved' && lesson!==null && aiCoaching.enabled && aiCoaching.endpointUrl) that calls fetchAiHint with { enabled, endpointUrl, timeoutMs:4000 } built from the persisted setting. On a non-null result it stores aiHint in local state; the render then builds localCoaching = coachPractice(...) and, when aiHint!==null, spreads to { ...localCoaching, hint: aiHint, source:'ai' } — replacing ONLY CoachingFeedback.hint and flipping source to 'ai'; strength/improvement/comparison stay the deterministic local values. Null keeps the local hint and source:'local'. The AI effect never blocks render, never surfaces a raw error, and is cleaned up via an `active` flag. It never touches outcome/badgeEarned/streak — score, XP, badges, and certificates remain untouched deterministic domain code.

Settings (src/ui/screens/SettingsScreen.tsx): added an 'AI coaching (optional)' card with (1) the data disclosure summarizing exactly what leaves the device (lesson id, practice prompt, suggested answer, truncated practice text) and that nothing is sent while off; (2) an acknowledgement checkbox (toggling it off also forces enabled:false); (3) an 'Enable AI hints' Switch that is DISABLED until disclosureAcknowledged, with onToggleEnabled refusing to enable without acknowledgement; (4) a TextInput endpoint-URL entry committed on blur (empty -> null). Each change persists through the provider's setAiCoaching(next: PersistedAiCoaching). Defense-in-depth: the store also coerces enabled->false without acknowledgement (FEAT-003).

Isolated server/ (NOT in the root package.json): server/package.json pins express 4.21.2 + @types/express 4.17.21 with its own name/scripts (no root changes; node_modules/lockfile only appear if someone runs npm install there, and are not committed). server/index.js exposes POST /coach/explain: re-validates { lessonId, prompt, suggestedAnswer } as non-empty strings + studentText as a string, re-truncates studentText to 2000, returns 200 { hint: string } with a deterministic canned hint (or 503 when FORCE_503=1 to exercise the client fallback; 400 on invalid). Any provider key is read from process.env.AI_PROVIDER_API_KEY SERVER-SIDE ONLY (a real provider call is a clearly-marked TODO). studentText is treated as untrusted (validated, re-truncated, never eval'd; the TODO notes it must go in a quoted data section). server/README.md documents key-server-only, the TODO, the stub behavior, and isolation.

docs/ai-coaching.md documents exactly what leaves the device when enabled + an endpoint is set (lesson id, practice prompt, suggested answer, truncated practice text, sent only to the user-configured endpoint), what is NOT sent (no name, no progression, no XP, no device identifiers), that nothing is sent while off (the default), and the pre-enable in-app disclosure/acknowledgement requirement.

__tests__/aiCoaching.test.ts (design 8 items 30-33; mocks global.fetch, restores it after each): (30) feature off/default + enabled-without-endpoint -> no network call, returns null, coaching source:'local'; (31) non-200 / network throw / AbortError -> null with no throw, integration falls back to the local hint; (32) a well-formed { hint } replaces ONLY the hint and sets source:'ai' (strength/improvement/comparison equal the local output), while missing-hint / non-string / empty / non-object bodies are rejected to local; (33) a response including score/xp/badge/certificate yields only the hint string, and the untrusted studentText is truncated to 2000 chars before being sent.

Incidental non-FEAT-005 edit: added 'server/*' to eslint.config.js ignores so the isolated CommonJS stub is not linted by the root flat config (tsconfig.json already excludes server/ from typecheck via its explicit include list, so the root typecheck/lint/validator are unaffected by server/).
